summary: Increased bilateral pleural effusions and pulmonary edema-like bilateral airspace opacity.

findings.rationale: Current image shows substantially larger veiling bibasal opacities with more blunted costophrenic angles bilaterally; AP technique may affect exact size.
There are new/worsened bilateral perihilar-to-lower lung fluffy opacities in a roughly symmetric edema pattern, though projection and support wires are confounders.
